meddocan.title: MEDDOCAN
meddocan.subtitle: Spanish clinical de-identification (synthetic)
meddocan.why_we_include_it: Largest *public* Spanish clinical de-id corpus. Every Spanish clinical NLP paper cites it. Reviewer-credible. No DUA required.
meddocan.example:
Nombre: Ignacio.
Apellidos: Rico Pedroza.
NHC: 5467980.
Domicilio: Av. Beniarda, 13.
Localidad/ Provincia: Valencia.
Fecha de nacimiento: 11/02/1970...

asq_phi.title: ASQ-PHI
asq_phi.subtitle: Adversarial Synthetic Queries for clinical PHI (English)
asq_phi.phi_density: ~3.6 PHI elements per positive query, 2,973 across corpus
asq_phi.why_we_include_it: Built for exactly the Guardian-Layer use case: clinician-style queries that need PHI removal before going to external LLM/search tools. Includes 219 hard negatives that test over-redaction — a unique signal no other dataset gives us.
asq_phi.example: What is the latest treatment protocol for a 34-year-old female diagnosed with MS like Anna S., previously treated at Methodist Hospital on April 12, 2023?

pii_masking_300k.title: PII-Masking-300k
pii_masking_300k.subtitle: Multilingual general PII (synthetic)
pii_masking_300k.phi_density: varies — usernames, emails, addresses, names, etc.
pii_masking_300k.why_we_include_it: Widens the comparison beyond Spanish clinical to general English PII. Human-validated (~98% token label accuracy). Complements MEDDOCAN's narrow clinical focus.
pii_masking_300k.example: On the video sharing platform for educational content, a lively discussion unfolded among users from different locales within the UK. The comment thread began with paaltwvkjuijwbj957 expressing admir...

pii_masking_300k_dutch.title: PII-Masking-300k (Dutch)
pii_masking_300k_dutch.subtitle: Dutch general PII (synthetic) — same corpus, different language
pii_masking_300k_dutch.phi_density: varies — usernames, emails, addresses, names, etc.
pii_masking_300k_dutch.why_we_include_it: Direct cross-language comparison: same task, same labels, different language. Reveals which systems generalise across languages versus which collapse on non-English text.
pii_masking_300k_dutch.example: Het programma was duidelijk gericht op een bepaalde demografie, voornamelijk personen die geboren zijn na 14-06-1953...

pii_masking_300k_french.title: PII-Masking-300k (French)
pii_masking_300k_french.subtitle: French general PII (synthetic) — same corpus, different language
pii_masking_300k_french.phi_density: varies — usernames, emails, addresses, names, etc.
pii_masking_300k_french.why_we_include_it: Romance-language cross-language stress test. Shows whether the systems generalise from English/Dutch to a different language family.
pii_masking_300k_french.example: Mon nom est Jean Dupont et je travaille à l'Hôpital Saint-Louis depuis le 14 mars 2018...

pii_masking_300k_german.title: PII-Masking-300k (German)
pii_masking_300k_german.subtitle: German general PII (synthetic) — same corpus, different language
pii_masking_300k_german.phi_density: varies — usernames, emails, addresses, names, etc.
pii_masking_300k_german.why_we_include_it: Germanic-language cross-language stress test. Combined with Dutch, lets us see whether close languages produce similar leaderboards.
pii_masking_300k_german.example: Mein Name ist Hans Müller, ich wurde am 22.03.1985 in Hamburg geboren und arbeite bei Siemens...

multiconer_v2.title: MultiCoNER v2
multiconer_v2.subtitle: Fine-grained noisy NER, 33 entity types
multiconer_v2.why_we_include_it: Wikipedia/forum noisy text with 33 fine-grained entity types (people, locations, medical, products). Tests whether PII detectors handle out-of-clinical-domain entities — important because the same prompts get sent to LLMs from many contexts.
multiconer_v2.example: the species was described by dietrich brandis after the forester t. f. bourdillon .
